usageNotes: Use this to take a point-in-time snapshot of a remote QEMU VM via PDM without needing direct PVE API access. The operation is asynchronous — the response is a remote UPID string that must be polled for completion status. Omitting 'vmstate' (default false) produces a disk-only snapshot; set it to true only when you need to resume the VM exactly from its running state, as RAM capture significantly increases snapshot time and disk usage.

examples.summary: Create a pre-upgrade disk-only snapshot of VM 105 on the production-pve remote

tips: snapname must start with a letter or digit and contain only alphanumeric, dot, underscore, or hyphen characters — max 40 chars.
If 'node' is omitted, PDM resolves the VM's current node automatically; supply it to be explicit in clusters with live migration.
RAM-state snapshots (vmstate: true) require the VM to be running and roughly double the storage footprint of the snapshot.
Poll the returned remote UPID against the task-status endpoint to confirm the snapshot completed before proceeding with destructive operations.
